annotation.method: Codex read the complete local paper, surveyed every named lemma, theorem, corollary, algorithm, displayed error bound, experiment, conclusion, and reference, visually checked all selected source pages, searched all 24 frozen mounted object modules, and compiled private N/L proofs before accepting the targets.
annotation.reason: The project owner assigned the P15 source selection and benchmark annotation to Codex.

corpus_membership: This paper is part of the current corpus listed in metadata/manifest.json.
paper_version: published journal version; IMA Journal of Numerical Analysis 42(2), 2022, printed pages 951-980

rejected_candidates.candidate: truncated-SVD definition (2.1), BLR representation (2.2)-(2.4), floating-point model (2.5), and experimental backward-error metric (2.11)
rejected_candidates.reason: These are definitions, assumptions, or measurement formulas rather than proved target conclusions.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Lemmas 2.1-2.3 on dense products, triangular solves, and LU factorization
rejected_candidates.reason: They are classical results recalled from Higham (2002), so their proofs are delegated rather than established in this paper.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Lemma 3.2 full-matrix forward error and Lemmas 3.3-3.4 low-rank matrix-product bounds
rejected_candidates.reason: These are viable results, but Lemma 3.1 is the cleanest source-faithful combine task and the selected T3 already exercises the paper's matrix-product error composition at greater depth.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Lemma 3.5 triangular system with a low-rank right-hand side
rejected_candidates.reason: It is an intermediate UCF factorization kernel; Theorem 4.5 provides the more central end-to-end solve certificate.

Its full blockwise recurrence is below the source-level Theorems 4.2-4.4 interface selected for Theorem 4.5; the T3 precision family still records the UFC/UCF block updates, factor/compress order, floating-point operations, compression semantics, output provenance, and successful completion before composing those established guarantees.

They are central algorithm-level guarantees recorded in the P15-T3 completed UFC/UCF execution certificate, but Theorem 4.5 extends them through both ordered triangular solves and is the paper's final stability theorem.
Its exact equations and bounds are recorded as the two solve stages in P15-T3; selecting the final theorem tests their nontrivial composition with the UFC/UCF factorization.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Tables, Figures 1-9, SuiteSparse experiments, flop comparisons, and implementation recommendations
rejected_candidates.reason: These are empirical comparisons or engineering recommendations rather than universally quantified proved statements.

T1.decision: Use the Frobenius submultiplicativity property fixed in Section 2.1 for every compatible rectangular real matrix product, with the paper's norm formula explicit; it is an exact direct match to the frozen matrix library.

T2.decision: Use the complete exact finite content of Lemma 3.1 equations (3.1)-(3.2), deriving the ordered X(Y^T v) stage perturbation, c = b + r^(3/2), and the truncation-plus-rounding bound with its retained epsilon-gamma cross term.

T3.decision: Use Theorem 4.5 over a precision family of completed UFC or UCF executions, retaining dense A versus represented Atilde, exact factor-rank semantics, algorithm-specific threshold and recompression traces, both ordered solves, existential aggregate perturbations, and uniform O(u epsilon) and O(u^2) remainders.

selection_policy: Use results proved or exact norm properties explicitly adopted in this paper, not empirical plots or results delegated to earlier sources.
Preserve the paper's Frobenius-norm setting and distinguish low-rank truncation errors from floating-point errors.
Formalize big-O terms uniformly over precision families; do not replace them by coefficients selected after an isolated run or expose proof-only finite coefficients in a controlled target.
Keep every public definition paper-scoped and free of NumStability imports.
Assign tiers only from the 24 modules in metadata/library_olean.json.
